claims.statement: QIK-VRT reads reality as information efficacy in relations: a difference becomes relevant where it changes possible connections, effects or admissible descriptions.
claims.boundary: This is the author's ontological and operational interpretation. It is not presented as a complete empirically exclusive ontology.

claims.statement: Vergrößere die Menge des Jetzt: include more affected people, consequences, evidence and correction possibilities in present responsibility.
claims.boundary: This is a normative imperative, not a mathematical theorem or a physical law.

claims.statement: For the declared observer-relative record model, increasing receiver-local change time together with decreasing authenticated source markers entails a negative comparative information-reference direction.
claims.boundary: The proof is conditional on the declared host order, source binding, information-bearing records and monotone receiver chain.

claims.statement: Incomplete evidence must not be used to invent a complete past; responsible recovery preserves only what remains invariant under declared observation and canonicalization rules.
claims.boundary: The observation-fibre relation formalizes a reasoning discipline. Its normative application to historical, political or personal cases requires case-specific evidence and judgment.

claims.statement: Responsibility means preserving future agency and refusing the reduction of persons to exploitable material, risk, file, target group or enemy image.
claims.boundary: This is an ethical position. It is not inferred as a compulsory moral code from physics or software alone.

claims.statement: Delayed-choice and quantum-eraser data support later context-dependent classification of earlier registered records while the unconditioned local marginal does not provide a selectable backward signal.
claims.boundary: The cited experiments do not uniquely select QIK-VRT or establish a controllable physical signal into the past.

claims.statement: Ingolf Lohmann asserts the QIK-VRT correspondence thesis: the universe is a distributed relational system and QIK-VRT describes reality within its claimed model scope.
claims.boundary: The authorial correspondence thesis remains distinct from the finite formal theorem, independent empirical confirmation and scientific consensus.

claims.statement: The declaration is a new current synthesis and preserves earlier QIK-VRT documents as historical intermediate states rather than overwriting their bytes or their former scope wording.
claims.boundary: A preserved predecessor remains evidence of its own historical content and does not automatically inherit later claims.
